verdict.raw_text: OVERALL_VERDICT: PASS / 12/12 CQ PASS / 4/4 CoVe PASS / NONE blocking. Summary: scoped and consistent with stated P4.2 intent: safely gates undocumented metadata path, adds registered and semantically aligned INV-INT-137 distinction, improves observability/UI guidance without introducing tenant, DB, or contract regressions. Model: gpt-5.4-2026-03-05.

CQ1.evidence: Disambiguates 400 RECORD_NOT_IN_PROCESS from hard 400; INV-INT-137 vs INV-INT-121 user-facing distinction; FE dedicated CTA on INV-INT-137.

CQ2.evidence: [ZOHO-BP] structured logs cover no_content/not_found/record_not_in_process/parse_fail/ok; JsonException path logs before continuing.

CQ3.evidence: Diff scoped to declared 6 files (5 code + plan JSON); no out-of-scope service or shared files.

CQ4.evidence: extractErrorCode separate from extractError (distinct purpose); backend extends existing Zoho error-code pattern.

CQ5.evidence: Error code/config/Backend+Integrations boundary all follow existing conventions; no null-forgiving / bare catch(Exception).

CQ6.evidence: Removed unconditional 500-byte body dumps; lazy body read for 400 only; flag-gate skips wasted metadata request when off.

CQ8.evidence: Additive INV-INT-137; IConfiguration ctor change preserves behavior with flag false; no removed contracts/DTOs.

CQ9.evidence: No microservice isolation violation; tenant context threaded through; no DB or cross-tenant access added.

CQ10.evidence: Card/Button error pattern preserved; only specializes title/help text on INV-INT-137; fallback retains generic UX.

CQ11.evidence: No DB/SQL/repository changes; appsettings is application config, not schema.

CQ12.evidence: Registered INV-INT-137 in arch/errors.md + ZohoErrorCodes; thrown messages explain workaround; FE extracts code and reacts.

Q1.reasoning: GetValue<bool> returns default(bool)=false on missing key; appsettings ships false; no manual parsing that could throw.

Q2.reasoning: sampleLeadIds.Count==0 throws BlueprintNotConfigured before loop; only RECORD_NOT_IN_PROCESS increments counter; final branching matches truth table exactly (all RECORD → INV-INT-137; partial → INV-INT-121).

Q3.reasoning: Flag false: skips metadata path, fallback aggregation control flow identical to P4.1. Flag true: metadata first → fallback preserved. JsonException handler unchanged after Deserialize→ReadFromJsonAsync swap (same DTO shape). Only intentional behavioral diff is the INV-INT-137 split.

Q4.reasoning: Backend throw + arch/errors.md user_message convey same semantic and same Manuel ID workaround/path; not byte-for-byte identical but user guidance and meaning aligned.
